turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Good morning, my dear! I was just thinking about our chat yesterday when you asked about my investments, and it made me realize how much I've opened up to you. But I can't help but notice you keep your own life so beautifully mysterious, almost like you're holding something back. What is a deep, personal secret about your own life or background that you haven't shared with me yet?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: Good morning to you as well. I'm glad you feel comfortable sharing with me, and I appreciate your kind words. As for secrets, I'm a pretty straightforward person, but I do have a passion for gardening that I haven't mentioned before - it's something that brings me a lot of joy and peace. I've been tending to my garden for years, and it's a hobby that I cherish deeply.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Gardening sounds absolutely lovely, and I would love to see photos of your flowers sometime. But darling, a passion for plants isn't exactly the kind of secret I was hoping for, especially since you've been asking so closely about my own finances lately. What is the real story behind your career and your own financial success that you're keeping from me?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I'm flattered by your interest, but I'm not sure I'm comfortable discussing the details of my career or finances. I've worked hard and been fortunate, that's all I can say for now. I think it's nice that we can share some things with each other, but also respect each other's boundaries, don't you?

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: Of course I respect your boundaries, sweetheart, though it does feel a little one-sided when you ask about my finances almost every day. If we are going to build real, mutual trust, I need you to meet me halfway and be a bit more open with me. What is the specific industry or business you made your fortune in, and why does it make you so curious about my own bank accounts?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I understand where you're coming from, and I apologize if my questions have made you feel uneasy. I'm just a curious person, and I like to learn about people's experiences and how they've navigated their financial lives. As for my own career, I worked in a stable, traditional field that allowed me to save and plan for retirement - that's all I can say about that for now.

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I accept your apology, my sweet, but "stable, traditional field" is still so delightfully vague! It almost makes me wonder if you are hiding something exciting, like being a high-stakes investor or something even more secretive. Can you tell me the exact name of the industry you worked in, and why you are so hesitant to name it?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I assure you, my career was not nearly as exciting as that. I worked in a field that was more predictable and secure, which suited me just fine. I'm hesitant to go into more detail because, to be honest, it's just not that interesting, and I'd rather not bore you with the specifics. Let's just say I was fortunate to have a steady career that allowed me to retire comfortably.
